q: Bases and alkalis are found in many ____ agents such as soap and many household detergents.
e: Bases and alkalis are found in many cleaning agents such as soap and many household detergents. Cleaning is the idea that completes this fact.

q: When wood ashes are burnt, the product is ____.
e: When wood ashes are burnt, the product is alkaline. Alkaline is the idea that completes this fact.

q: The word alkali comes from the Arabic 'al-qili' which means ____.
e: The word alkali comes from the Arabic 'al-qili' which means burnt ashes. Burnt ashes is the idea that completes this fact.

q: A base is usually a metallic oxide or hydroxide and will react with an acid to form a salt and ____ only.
e: A base is usually a metallic oxide or hydroxide and will react with an acid to form a salt and water only. Water is the idea that completes this fact.

q: An alkali is a base that is ____ in water.
e: An alkali is a base that is soluble in water. An alkali is a soluble base that produces OH- ions in water.

q: Alkalis can be strong or ____.
e: Alkalis can be strong or weak. Weak is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Strong alkalis dissolve in water to produce ____ ions in solution.
e: Strong alkalis dissolve in water to produce OH- ions in solution. An alkali is a soluble base that produces OH- ions in water.

q: Sodium hydroxide and potassium hydroxide are examples of ____ alkalis.
e: Sodium hydroxide and potassium hydroxide are examples of strong alkalis. Strong is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Ammonium hydroxide is the most common example of a ____ alkali.
e: Ammonium hydroxide is the most common example of a weak alkali. Weak is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Most bases are ____ in water.
e: Most bases are insoluble in water. Insoluble is the idea that completes this fact.

q: MgO, CuO, $Fe_2O_3$, etc. are ____ bases.
e: MgO, CuO, Fe2O3, etc. are insoluble bases. Insoluble is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Strong bases are ____ to handle.
e: Strong bases are hazardous to handle. Hazardous is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Bases have a ____ taste and soapy feel.
e: Bases have a bitter taste and soapy feel. Bitter is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Bases cause a colour change in indicators. Litmus changes from red to ____ in a basic solution.
e: Bases cause a colour change in indicators. Litmus changes from red to blue in a basic solution. Blue is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Alkalis have pH values greater than ____.
e: Alkalis have pH values greater than 7. pH measures how acidic or alkaline a solution is, with 7 as neutral.

q: Bases react with acids to ____ each other and form a salt and water.
e: Bases react with acids to neutralise each other and form a salt and water. Neutralise is the idea that completes this fact.

q: When alkalis are gently warmed with ammonium salt, the products include a salt, water and ____.
e: When alkalis are gently warmed with ammonium salt, the products include a salt, water and ammonia. Ammonia is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Alkalis react with fatty acids to form ____.
e: Alkalis react with fatty acids to form soaps. Turning fat into soap is an old chemical change, a kind of saponification.

q: ____ is used in making soap, paper, baking soda, oven cleaners.
e: Sodium hydroxide is used in making soap, paper, baking soda, oven cleaners. Sodium hydroxide is the idea that completes this fact.

q: ____ is used in treating acidic soil (liming), making cement, limewater, mortar, plaster.
e: Calcium hydroxide (slaked lime) is used in treating acidic soil (liming), making cement, limewater, mortar, plaster. Calcium hydroxide (slaked lime) is the idea that completes this fact.

q: ____ is used in making cement (quicklime).
e: Calcium oxide is used in making cement (quicklime). Calcium oxide is the idea that completes this fact.

q: ____ is used in antacids (gastric medicine), in toothpaste.
e: Magnesium oxide is used in antacids (gastric medicine), in toothpaste. Magnesium oxide is the idea that completes this fact.

q: ____ is used in many household cleaners and production of ammonia fertilisers.
e: NH4OH is used in many household cleaners and production of ammonia fertilisers. NH4OH is the idea that completes this fact.

q: A base or an alkali is a chemical compound that combines with an acid to form a salt and ____.
e: A base or an alkali is a chemical compound that combines with an acid to form a salt and water. Water is the idea that completes this fact.

q: An alkali is a base which is soluble in water producing ____ ions.
e: An alkali is a base which is soluble in water producing OH- ions. OH- is the idea that completes this fact.

q: All alkalis are bases but all bases are not ____.
e: All alkalis are bases but all bases are not alkalis. An alkali is a soluble base that produces OH- ions in water.

q: A strong base is a base that ____ dissociates in water producing $OH^-$ ions.
e: A strong base is a base that completely dissociates in water producing OH- ions. Completely is the idea that completes this fact.

q: A weak base is a base that ____ dissociates in water producing $OH^-$ ions.
e: A weak base is a base that partially dissociates in water producing OH- ions. Partially is the idea that completes this fact.
